title: MobLand
description:
S02 E01 — I Wanna Be Your Dog
Maeve and Conrad go to the dogs, leaving Harry to deal with the messy fallout; Jan makes a startling confession; Kevin and Seraphina both look to the future; Tattersall puts his cards on the table.
